prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 1536×1024 landscape viewport, no device frame
Primary request: Design a shippable-looking Athena target-product UI called “测试旅程票夹” using the visual grammar of a jet-age airline ticket wallet, while remaining a serious software testing workbench. This is a north-star comp, not concept art.
Scene/backdrop: full browser viewport; crisp white coupon stock over a carrier-navy application ground, restrained and usable in a bright office.
Subject: Athena connects one testing intent across requirement evidence, generated test cases, generated script, deterministic validation, review, controlled execution, result evidence, and RCA. Show one journey as a continuous coupon book. Use fixed fields for revision, source, environment, owner, and Attempt; validated, used, and void states remain visible rather than disappearing.
Style/medium: realistic enterprise product UI; exact field grids, hairline rules, tabbed coupon headers, carbon-copy numerals, audit stamps; not a poster and not skeuomorphic illustration.
Composition/framing: left narrow product navigation with Athena and modules 首页 / 智能工作区 / 测试 / 运行 / 知识; central 70% is a large unfolded coupon sequence with six connected stages; right 24% is an evidence inspector showing source revision and verification state. One dominant selected coupon “TC-042 超额退款需二次审批” expands with a concise script-validation summary. Clear reading order and practical controls.
Color palette: carrier navy #112A46, signal red #C83932, crisp white #FBFAF5, carbon purple #5B3B76; no gradients.
Materials/textures: subtle coupon-stock paper, carbon-copy ink, perforation rules, tabbed fields, restrained VOID / 已验证 stamps.
Text (verbatim): “Athena”; “目标态 · 合成示例”; “退款审批规则”; “需求”; “用例”; “脚本”; “验证”; “执行”; “证据”; “RCA”; “TC-042 超额退款需二次审批”; “3 个来源 revision”; “8 个候选用例 · 2 个待评审”; “Run #184 · Attempt 2”; “17 / 18 passed”; “候选”; “已验证”.
Constraints: render Chinese text accurately and sparingly; clearly mark all future product capability as “目标态 · 合成示例”; use product-native object names, not aviation jargon; show practical enterprise controls and state hierarchy; no invented customers, benchmarks, prices, logos, or commercial claims; no watermark.
Avoid: generic AI chat screen, KPI card dashboard, Greek mythology, owl or temple motifs, glassmorphism, neon, gradients, rounded-card soup, airline photos, decorative boarding-pass mockup, tiny unreadable text.
